admission.workflow: Own an Attempt-scoped remote workspace overlay, protected recovery, five-mutation persistence and reconciliation contract, plus a caller-side filesystem projection and separate read-only Exam Resource catalog.

items.rationale: Canonical Microsoft MIT text for the reviewed filesystem and working-copy evidence.
Retain scheme-scoped provider operations, typed errors, immutable stats and invalidation events while replacing generic filesystem authority and URI identity with Attempt-scoped stable references.
Retain strict provider-boundary validation and error translation at the caller adapter without allowing registration or provider capability flags to grant authorization.
Retain explicit working, dirty, save, revert, capability and event semantics while exposing Proctor's orthogonal content, mutation, protection, availability and access facts.

Retain serialized overlapping saves, concurrent-edit preservation, conflict state, backup-first close and explicit revert, adapted to opaque server versions, exact mutation outcomes and protected local recovery.
Retain durable backup records and discard-after-save behavior behind a privileged protected-content port using opaque storage identifiers rather than a renderer-visible backup filesystem.

dependencies.rationale: Events, disposal and cancellation retain deterministic lifecycle semantics.
The production server transport remains unresolved behind the exact authoritative port.
Production encryption, key custody and atomic native storage remain unresolved behind the protected-content port.

divergences.summary: Stable entry references, opaque content versions, authoritative cursors, exact acknowledgements and submission blockers replace local URI, mtime and editor-cleanliness assumptions.

Recovery protection is an independent durability fact; scoped records reload the overlay after relaunch, while conflict, rejection, unknown outcome and authorization loss retain local work until acknowledgement or explicit discard.
The public seam admits only whole current-file reads and five single mutation families; unsupported server batch, history, range, revert and conflict operations are explicit false capabilities.

verification.obligation: Verify state separation, five mutations, stable identity, idempotency, cancellation, cursor gaps, overlay reapplication and relaunch recovery, bounded concurrency, subtree serialization, protected conflict sides, safe text rebase, revocation, dual-path durability gating, limits and submission blockers.

Verify scoped URI projection, acknowledged writes, hierarchy enumeration, watch-filtered invalidation events, rich-to-coarse error translation and retention of locally protected unacknowledged writes.
Verify Exam Resources remain separately authorized and read only.
Verify layer direction, environment placement, cycle absence and interface-test ownership.
Verify every reviewed filesystem and working-copy evidence blob at the exact pinned VS Code revision.
